headline: Daily Market Snapshot — November 11, 2026
summary: US equities fell Tuesday on hot October CPI (+0.4% MoM vs 0.3% est), locking in a December Fed hike; Nasdaq -0.74%, S&P 500 -0.38%, Dow -0.30%. Wednesday premarket tech rebound led by CoreWeave earnings beat; Nasdaq-100 futures +1.6%. 10-year Treasury near 5%, dollar rally, crypto sold off on liquidations.
key_facts: Nasdaq-100 futures +1.6% premarket Nov 11; S&P 500 futures +0.7%
VIX ~25 week of Nov 9 (peaked at 28.18 on Nov 5)

headline: Hot October inflation report rattles markets
summary: US October CPI rose 0.4% month-over-month, above the 0.3% forecast, while core CPI increased 0.3% versus the 0.2% expected, marking a third consecutive upside surprise. The report drove a broad market selloff and pushed the 10-year Treasury yield to nearly 5%, effectively locking in a December Federal Reserve rate hike with some analysts raising the possibility of a 50-basis-point move.
key_facts: Energy major driver; also shelter and food
BLS did not publish YoY rate due to 2025 government shutdown data gap

headline: October CPI clears the way for December Fed rate hike
summary: The hot October 2026 CPI report effectively locked in a December Federal Reserve rate hike, with CME FedWatch showing odds near 100% for at least a 25-basis-point move at the December 8-9 FOMC meeting. Some analysts raised the possibility of a 50-basis-point increase, and one analyst noted CPI hot for three straight months could mean hikes spill into 2027.
key_facts: Fed effective funds rate 3.88%; target range 3.75-4.00%
CPI hot for third consecutive month

headline: Fed Governor Waller raises possibility of 50bp December rate hike after hot CPI
summary: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller raised the possibility of a 50-basis-point rate hike at the December FOMC meeting following the hotter-than-expected October CPI report. The 2-year Treasury yield jumped 17.6 basis points to 4.738% as markets priced in an increasingly aggressive Fed response to sticky inflation.

headline: 10-year Treasury yield jumps near 5% as hot inflation lifts rate-hike odds
summary: The 10-year US Treasury yield surged to approximately 4.99% on November 10, 2026, rising about 11 basis points following the hotter-than-expected October CPI report. The move reflected sharply higher odds of a December Federal Reserve rate hike; the yield had been falling since it topped 5.30% in early October.
key_facts: Had peaked at 5.30% in early October

headline: Cleveland Fed nowcast: November CPI 3.88% YoY; Q4 2026 annualized CPI 4.24%
summary: The Cleveland Fed's inflation nowcast places year-over-year CPI at approximately 3.88% for November 2026 and core PCE at 3.31%, with a Q4 2026 annualized CPI nowcast of 4.24%, reflecting sustained inflationary pressures that complicate the Fed's December policy decision.

headline: S&P 500 closes at 7,549.94 after 2.35% rally on November 9
summary: The S&P 500 index closed at 7,549.94 on Monday November 9, 2026, gaining 2.35% (173 points) from its November 6 close of 7,376.86 as markets recovered from the election-related volatility, before giving back gains on Tuesday's inflation data.

headline: S&P 500 falls 0.38%, Nasdaq drops 0.74% after hot October CPI
summary: US stocks declined on Tuesday November 10, 2026, as hotter-than-expected October CPI data rattled markets and pushed the 10-year Treasury yield to nearly 5%. The S&P 500 fell 0.38%, the Nasdaq Composite declined 0.74%, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average shed 0.30%, with Nvidia leading losses in the technology sector, falling over 5%.
key_facts: Hot CPI: October +0.4% MoM vs 0.3% expected

headline: S&P 500 futures +0.7%, Nasdaq-100 futures +1.6% premarket; Bessent urges US-China de-risk
summary: US stock futures climbed Wednesday November 11, 2026, with Nasdaq-100 futures up roughly 1.6% and S&P 500 futures gaining about 0.7%, as CoreWeave's strong after-hours earnings report drove tech sentiment and Treasury Secretary Bessent urged US-China economic de-risking. Intel rose about 5% and Nvidia gained roughly 3% premarket.

headline: Treasury Secretary Bessent urges US and China to de-risk economic relationship
summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent urged the United States and China to de-risk their economic relationship, comments that contributed to positive market tone in premarket trading on November 11, 2026, amid ongoing US-China trade tensions.
key_facts: Comments supported equity futures premarket Nov 11

headline: VIX elevated near 25; spiked 70% on election day November 5 for third-biggest jump since 1990
summary: The CBOE VIX volatility index stood near 25 for the week of November 9, 2026, elevated after surging 69.7% on November 5 to 28.18 as Democratic midterm victories triggered a broad market selloff and SPY fell 4.4%. CBOE noted no contagion in macro volatility despite elevated equity vol.
key_facts: Third-biggest one-day VIX pct jump since 1990

headline: Nikkei 225 rises 1.31% to 61,248 as Asia-Pacific markets rebound; Kospi jumps 2.6%
summary: Japan's Nikkei 225 closed up 1.31% at 61,248.59 on Wednesday November 11, 2026, while South Korea's Kospi surged 2.6% to 5,375.36, leading an Asia-Pacific rebound despite headwinds from Tuesday's hot US inflation print. Hong Kong's Hang Seng fell 0.7%, bucking the trend.
key_facts: Asia rebound driven by tech sentiment from CoreWeave earnings

headline: Europe stocks gain; Stoxx 600 +0.29%, DAX +0.73%; Infineon +6.3%, ASMI +5.5%
summary: European equities gained on November 11, 2026, with the pan-European Stoxx 600 rising 0.29% and Germany's DAX adding 0.73%, led by chip stocks tracking CoreWeave-driven tech sentiment. Infineon Technologies advanced 6.3% and ASMI rose 5.5% as AI semiconductor enthusiasm rebounded.
key_facts: Chip stocks leading gains on CoreWeave earnings

headline: Saxo: Asian markets set to open lower as hot US inflation drives Wall Street selloff
summary: Saxo Bank's Asia market quick take for November 11, 2026 noted Asian markets were initially positioned to open lower after Tuesday's US inflation-driven selloff, with Nikkei futures down 0.5% at pre-market. The 10-year US Treasury yield near 5% and stronger US dollar posed headwinds, though markets ultimately closed higher.
key_facts: Asian markets expected lower after US CPI

headline: CoreWeave Q3 2026: revenue surges 168% to $3.66B, backlog $132.5B, raises FY guide
summary: CoreWeave reported Q3 2026 revenue of $3.66 billion, up 168% year-over-year, beating analyst estimates, with a backlog of $132.5 billion. The AI cloud infrastructure company raised its full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $13.0–$13.3 billion. Shares rose about 5.7% after-hours to $51.51 from a close of $48.73, though the stock remained more than 57% below its 52-week high of $138.25.

headline: CoreWeave stock after earnings: is $47B debt a risk?
summary: Analysts flagged CoreWeave's nearly $47 billion in debt after its Q3 2026 earnings report, noting one of its bonds yielded 15.5% on Tuesday. The company plans to spend $37–$39 billion in 2026 capital expenditures, raising questions about long-term financial sustainability despite the strong revenue growth.
key_facts: Total debt ~$47B as of end Q3
Revenue grew 168% YoY despite heavy debt load

headline: Palantir tops Q3 2026 estimates but shares fall; US commercial revenue overtakes government
summary: Palantir Technologies reported Q3 2026 adjusted EPS of $0.44, beating the $0.41 consensus, on revenue of $2.31 billion up 96% year-over-year and above the $2.18 billion estimate. The company raised its full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $8.530–$8.534 billion, but shares fell about 3% in after-hours trading on concerns about decelerating commercial contract growth. US commercial revenue overtook US government revenue for the first time.
key_facts: US commercial revenue overtook US gov for first time

headline: ConocoPhillips Q3 2026: EPS beat, 11% dividend raise, $4B free cash flow
summary: ConocoPhillips reported Q3 2026 adjusted EPS of $3.27, beating the $3.04 consensus estimate, with adjusted earnings of $3.9 billion versus $2.0 billion a year earlier. The company raised its quarterly ordinary dividend by 11% to $0.93 per share and returned $3.4 billion to shareholders in the quarter, including $2.4 billion in buybacks.

headline: AMD Q3 2026 record revenue $13.4B, up 45% year-over-year on data center strength
summary: Advanced Micro Devices reported record Q3 2026 revenue of $13.4 billion, up 45% year-over-year, driven by data center GPU and EPYC server processor strength. Despite the strong print, AMD shares initially fell 17.26% before recovering 11.04% to close at $449.04, with the subsequent Oppenheimer upgrade on November 9 adding further momentum.

headline: Oppenheimer upgrades AMD to Outperform with $600 price target; data center revenue seen +135% in 2027
summary: Oppenheimer upgraded Advanced Micro Devices to Outperform from Perform on November 9, 2026, with a $600 price target, citing record Q3 revenue and undeniable data center success. The firm projects AMD data center revenue to grow 135% year-over-year in 2027, with AI GPU sales expected to surpass EPYC server CPU revenue. AMD shares jumped 8.5–12% on the upgrade.
key_facts: AI GPU sales projected to surpass EPYC by 2027

headline: Nvidia cut to Hold by Aletheia; Wells Fargo cuts price target to $300 from $315
summary: Aletheia downgraded Nvidia from Buy to Hold without a price target on November 10, while Wells Fargo maintained its Overweight rating but trimmed its price target from $315 to $300. Nvidia shares had fallen over 5% on Tuesday and were showing premarket recovery on Wednesday.
key_facts: Aletheia cut NVDA to Hold from Buy (no target)

headline: Stifel downgrades DraftKings to Hold, cuts price target to $21 from $32
summary: Stifel analyst Jeffrey Stantial downgraded DraftKings from Buy to Hold and cut the price target from $32 to $21 on November 9, 2026, citing deteriorating risk/reward and competitive pressures in the online sports betting market.

headline: Morgan Stanley downgrades PDD Holdings to Equal-Weight, cuts target to $90 from $129
summary: Morgan Stanley analyst Eddy Wang downgraded PDD Holdings from Overweight to Equal-Weight on November 9, 2026, cutting the price target from $129 to $90 citing growth deceleration concerns in the Chinese e-commerce giant.

headline: Bank of America cuts Marvell price target to $225 from $400 after Lumentum acquisition
summary: Bank of America slashed Marvell Technology's price target from $400 to $225 following the company's $115 billion all-stock acquisition of Lumentum, while simultaneously downgrading Lumentum, reflecting concerns about deal dilution and the complexity of integrating a large optical components business.
key_facts: Deal dilution and integration risk cited

headline: Marvell agrees to acquire Lumentum in $115B all-stock AI connectivity deal
summary: Marvell Technology agreed on November 2, 2026 to acquire Lumentum Holdings in an all-stock deal valued at $115 billion enterprise value, described as the largest semiconductor acquisition ever announced. Lumentum stockholders will receive 4.5 Marvell shares per share, representing a 23.9% premium. The deal aims to combine Marvell's custom compute silicon with Lumentum's lasers and optical transceivers for AI data centers and is expected to close in H1 2028.
key_facts: Exchange ratio 4.5 MRVL shares per LITE share
Described as largest semiconductor acquisition ever announced

headline: Fox Corporation agrees to acquire Roku for $22 billion in landmark streaming deal
summary: Fox Corporation agreed in June 2026 to acquire Roku in a $22 billion cash-and-stock deal at $160 per Roku share ($96 cash plus 0.9693 Fox Class A shares). Fox expects approximately $400 million in annual run-rate cost synergies and the deal is pending regulatory and shareholder approvals, with closing expected in H1 2027. Roku founder Anthony Wood will join the Fox Board.

headline: argenx acquires Unnatural Products biotech for up to $1.145B
summary: argenx agreed on November 9, 2026 to acquire Unnatural Products, a California-based biotech with a macrocyclic peptide discovery platform, for up to $1.145 billion including $550 million upfront, adding pipeline capabilities to complement argenx's antibody-based programs.

headline: EQT proposed $13B acquisition of Range Resources still pending
summary: EQT Corporation's proposed acquisition of natural gas producer Range Resources for approximately $13 billion was still pending regulatory approval as of November 6, 2026, one of five major M&A transactions announced in the first week of November totaling roughly $49.2 billion.
key_facts: Pending regulatory approval as of Nov 6

headline: 2026 biopharma M&A tracker: 77 deals, ~$208.9B total; Eli Lilly most active buyer with 13 deals
summary: Biobucks' 2026 biopharma M&A tracker shows 77 acquisitions through early November with approximately $208.9 billion in disclosed value. Eli Lilly led big pharma acquirers with 13 deals. Top deals include Recordati/CVC-GBL at $12.4 billion, Organon/Sun Pharma at $11.8 billion, and Bio-Techne/Merck KGaA at $11.3 billion.

headline: ANI Pharmaceuticals makes $560M recommended offer for Egetis Therapeutics
summary: ANI Pharmaceuticals made a recommended public offer for Sweden's Egetis Therapeutics in a deal valued at approximately $560 million as announced in early November 2026, in a cross-border US-Swedish pharma transaction.

headline: LS Power acquires 6 natural gas power plants from NRG Energy for $4B
summary: LS Power agreed to acquire six natural gas power plants from NRG Energy for approximately $4 billion, continuing consolidation in the US power generation sector amid elevated demand from AI data center buildout.
key_facts: AI data center demand driving energy M&A

headline: Crypto market down: BTC near $73,730, $724M in long liquidations following hot CPI
summary: Bitcoin fell to approximately $73,730 on November 11, 2026, amid broader risk-off sentiment triggered by the hotter-than-expected October CPI report. Some $723.67 million in cryptocurrency long positions were liquidated within 24 hours, as rising rate-hike odds pressured risk assets. Spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $95 million in outflows on Tuesday.
key_facts: Spot BTC ETF outflows $95M on Nov 10

headline: Ethereum and XRP struggle to find support amid spot ETF outflows and rate-hike risk
summary: Ethereum fell to approximately $2,062 on November 11, 2026, down about 2.3–3.24% over 24 hours, as crypto markets repriced risk following hot US inflation data and rising Fed rate-hike odds. Spot ETF outflows and $724 million in liquidations added to downside pressure across the asset class.
key_facts: Spot ETF outflows contributing to pressure

headline: Hot US CPI sends gold below $4,100 as dollar rallies; gold spot ~$4,056
summary: Gold prices fell to approximately $4,056 per ounce on November 11, 2026, dropping below the key $4,100 level as the hot October CPI report drove the US dollar higher and pushed up Fed rate-hike expectations. Gold had closed at $4,030.20 on Monday, rising on safe-haven flows before the CPI data.

headline: Oil falls as Trump downplays further US strikes against Iran; WTI near $86
summary: WTI crude oil fell to approximately $86.22 per barrel on November 11, 2026, after US President Donald Trump downplayed the likelihood of further strikes against Iran, easing geopolitical risk premiums in the energy market. The move followed a volatile period driven by Middle East tensions.

headline: US Dollar Index rallies to 102.32 as October CPI exceeds estimates
summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY) rose to approximately 102.32–102.36 on November 10–11, 2026, gaining about 0.70% after the October CPI report beat forecasts and reinforced expectations of a December Federal Reserve rate hike. The dollar's strength weighed on gold, euro, and emerging market currencies.
key_facts: Fed December hike expectations drive dollar higher

headline: USD/JPY rises to 158.76-158.88, eyes breakout of seven-week consolidation
summary: USD/JPY climbed to approximately 158.76–158.88 on November 11, 2026, up about 0.55% as hotter US inflation data widened the interest rate differential between the US and Japan. The pair approaches the top of its seven-week consolidation range near 159.00, with Bank of Japan intervention risk capping further upside.

headline: EUR/USD falls below 1.1200 to 1.1166 as hot CPI reinforces hawkish Fed outlook
summary: EUR/USD fell to approximately 1.1166 on November 11, 2026, below the key 1.1200 support level, as the hot US October CPI report reinforced hawkish Federal Reserve expectations and strengthened the US dollar broadly. The Canadian dollar also came under pressure from the same dynamics.
key_facts: Dollar strength driven by hot CPI and Fed hike expectations

headline: PEPGEN surges 95.6%, OpenDoor gains 79%, TTEC rises 77.9% as top small-cap session gainers
summary: PepGen (PEPG) surged approximately 95.61% in Tuesday's session to lead all US market movers, with OpenDoor Technologies (OPENZ) gaining about 79.02% and TTEC Holdings advancing about 77.86% as small-cap stocks experienced extreme single-day moves.

headline: iHeartMedia plunges 65.9%, BMGL and MVST also drop sharply as small-cap losers
summary: iHeartMedia (IHRT) fell approximately 65.93% on Tuesday to lead all small-cap decliners, while Biomea Genetics (BMGL) dropped about 64.07% and Microvast Holdings (MVST) declined about 64.02%.

headline: Charter Communications leads S&P 500 gainers at +9.68%; Carvana top loser at -6.32%
summary: Charter Communications (CHTR) rose approximately 9.68% to lead S&P 500 gainers in Tuesday's session, with Carvana (CVNA) the index's biggest loser at approximately -6.32%.

headline: Charter Communications posts Q3 loss on $6.3B impairment, announces $2B cost-savings operating model
summary: Charter Communications reported a Q3 2026 GAAP net loss of $20.50 per share, driven by a $6.3 billion non-cash franchise impairment, though adjusted EPS of $21.70 significantly beat the $9.08 consensus estimate. The company lost about 233,000 internet customers on a pro forma basis and announced a new operating model targeting $2 billion in annualized cost savings over 18 months on top of Cox synergies. Shares fell 6.19% on November 6.

headline: GE Vernova down ~14% over past month on AI spending concerns and election derisking
summary: GE Vernova (GEV) stock was trading near $774 on November 9, 2026, having declined approximately 14% from $989 to $862 between October 2 and November 2 due to AI infrastructure spending concerns, with a further 7.48% drop on November 5 following Democratic midterm wins. BMO maintained an Outperform rating with a $1,200 price target, calling the sell-off a knee-jerk reaction.

headline: UnitedHealth top Dow gainer at +1.89% to $405.12 as Dow falls 0.30%
summary: UnitedHealth Group was the top gainer on the Dow Jones Industrial Average on November 10, 2026, rising 1.89% to close at $405.12, as the Dow Jones fell 0.30% overall on the session driven by inflation concerns.

headline: S&P 500 blended Q3 2026 earnings growth 31.4% with 88.2% of companies reported
summary: FactSet's November 6, 2026 earnings season update shows blended Q3 earnings growth for the S&P 500 at 31.4% year-over-year, up from 30.1% the prior week, with 88.2% of S&P 500 members having reported. Blended revenue growth stands at 14.3%.
key_facts: 88.2% of S&P 500 members reported by Nov 6
Blended Q3 earnings growth +31.4% YoY (up from 30.1%)

headline: October CPI: Inflation trended higher as energy prices hit consumers
summary: October 2026 CPI trended higher at +0.4% month-over-month, with energy prices being a major driver as October marked the peak of the second large oil price shock of 2026. Shelter and food also contributed, with the report showing a broader reacceleration of consumer prices.
key_facts: Energy major driver: October peak of second 2026 oil price shock

headline: Fossil Group Q3 2026: EPS $0.23 beats -$0.04 consensus estimate
summary: Fossil Group reported Q3 2026 earnings of $0.23 per share on November 10, 2026, significantly beating the consensus estimate of -$0.04, representing a substantial positive earnings surprise for the watches and accessories maker.

headline: Qnity Electronics Q3 2026 Net Sales $1.6B +22% YoY; full-year guidance raised
summary: Qnity Electronics reported Q3 2026 net sales and organic sales of $1.6 billion, up 22% year-over-year, and raised its full-year guidance, reflecting broad-based demand across its electronics segments.

headline: Nova Ltd Q3 2026 revenues $287.8M, up 13% QoQ as semiconductor equipment demand holds
summary: Nova Ltd reported total revenues of $287.8 million for Q3 2026, up 13% compared with Q2 2026, as demand for semiconductor process control equipment remained robust in the AI-driven semiconductor production cycle.
key_facts: Semiconductor process control equipment demand robust

headline: Take-Two confirms Grand Theft Auto VI releasing November 19, 2026
summary: Take-Two Interactive confirmed Grand Theft Auto VI will release on November 19, 2026, after the game was delayed from its original May 2026 launch window. CEO Strauss Zelnick projects record fiscal 2027 bookings driven by the launch. The stock had surged ~10% on the confirmation but has faced downward pressure since.
key_facts: GTA VI release date confirmed: Nov 19, 2026
Delayed from original May 2026 date (itself delayed from Fall 2025)
Take-Two CEO projects record FY2027 bookings
Stock +~10% on confirmation then drifted lower

headline: Energy sector Q3 2026 earnings projected +134% YoY, second-highest S&P 500 sector growth
summary: Zacks projected energy sector Q3 2026 earnings to rise approximately 134% year-over-year, the second-highest growth rate among S&P 500 sectors, driven by oil prices nearly $100 per barrel for ConocoPhillips and others. ConocoPhillips reported a realized crude price of $99.40 per barrel in Q3, up from $64.23 a year ago.
key_facts: Energy sector Q3 EPS growth projected +134% YoY
Saudi Aramco largest energy co by market cap ~$1.69T

headline: PSP Investments acquires 50% Enercare stake from Brookfield for $1.1B
summary: PSP Investments agreed on November 9, 2026 to acquire a 50% stake in Enercare, a Canadian residential energy and HVAC services company, from Brookfield for $1.1 billion, as infrastructure investors sought stable recurring revenue businesses.
